query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, status, started_at, completed_at FROM saga_execution WHERE id = ANY($1) ORDER BY id, started_at DESC
SELECT saga_id, step_name, phase, count(*) FROM saga_step_result WHERE saga_id = ANY($1) GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*) > $2
SELECT xact_commit, tup_inserted, tup_updated, numbackends FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = $1
SELECT parent_id, child_id FROM saga_join_branch WHERE parent_id = ANY($1)
